description: Named, versioned perturbations of the matched pelvis->thorax rotation series (SPN-13b, issue #12767). Each variant changes one golf-term registry value by an SO(3) composition with a rotation about that term's ISB isb_spine JCS axis; the other JCS terms are invariant by construction. Parameter bounds and term_bounds_deg are declared study-design limits (assumptions), not cited ranges of motion; the target model's own coordinate ranges are checked separately (check_coordinate_ranges).

variants.description: Scale the X-factor (x_factor_jcs_axial) at the top of the backswing, e.g. x0.8 or x1.2, with a smooth raised-cosine ramp from address and back to the original by impact.
variants.formula: R'(t) = R(t) Ry(s (k-1) x(t) w(t)); x = x_factor_jcs_axial, s = handed sign (-1 right, +1 left), w = raised-cosine window equal to 1 at top

variants.description: Add (positive) or remove (negative) lead lateral flexion (trunk_lateral_flexion_jcs) during the downswing, ramping in from the top to the full offset at impact and out after impact.
variants.formula: R'(t) = R(t) Ry(AR)^T Rx(s d w(t)) Ry(AR); rotation about the JCS floating axis, d = offset_deg, s = handed sign

variants.description: Scale lead lateral flexion (trunk_lateral_flexion_jcs) through the downswing; factor 0 removes it at impact, factor 2 doubles it.
variants.formula: R'(t) = R(t) Ry(AR)^T Rx(s (k-1) l(t) w(t)) Ry(AR); l = trunk_lateral_flexion_jcs

variants.description: Change trunk extension (trunk_extension_jcs) at impact, a pelvis-relative proxy for the reverse-spine-angle posture; positive adds extension.
variants.formula: R'(t) = Rz(d w(t)) R(t); rotation about the pelvis (proximal) Z axis, d = offset_deg, not handed

variants.description: Shift the time of peak X-factor relative to the pelvis by a whole number of samples (positive = later), keeping its peak value, by a monotone piecewise-linear time warp between address and impact.
variants.formula: R'(t) = R(t) Ry(s (x(tau(t)) - x(t))); tau piecewise linear with tau(t_a) = t_a, tau(t_p + shift) = t_p, tau(t_i) = t_i
